info.name: Maintain Ops Suite
info.summary: Integrated operations management — assets, PM, deficiencies, modernizations, supply, and Gantt scheduling
info.description:
Maintain Ops Suite is a comprehensive operations management platform built for field operations teams, maintenance departments, facilities managers, and organizations that need to track equipment, manage preventive maintenance, and control deficiency resolution workflows.
**Configuration Registry** Hardware, software, and firmware digital twin with full cross-linking. Assets are tracked with manufacturer, model, serial number, version, location, IP address, warranty expiry, and installation date. Supports ISO/IEC 15459 Unique Item Identifiers (UII) and DoD IUID compliance. Assets require 18-month verification cycles tracked automatically.
**Preventive Maintenance** Schedule and track PM procedures linked to configuration assets. Track periodicity (weekly through annual), last completed, next due date, assigned technician, and linked SOP documents. Automatically calculates next-due dates and flags overdue items. Captures actual hours, parts cost, labor cost, and completion notes on closeout.
**Deficiency Tracking** Log and manage deficiencies found during PM inspections or discovered on walkdowns. Tracks severity (SEV-1 through SEV-5), troubleshooting history, cost estimates, man-days, outside entity requirements, and assignment to Nextcloud users. Full closeout workflow captures root cause, corrective action, and actual costs. Deficiencies can be escalated directly into modernization projects.
**Modernizations** Full lifecycle management for asset upgrade projects. Five-stage workflow (Design → Planning → Approval → Execution → Complete) with automatic approval timestamping. Includes Technical Data Package (TDP) management for drawings, tech manuals, test plans, training materials, and SOPs. Links deficiencies, supply requests, and costs in one place.
**Availability Projects & Gantt** Project manage multiple work items on a visual Gantt chart within a defined availability window. Add PMs, modernizations, deficiencies, and milestones. Color-coded bars with dependency arrows. Click any bar for a detail popup. Out-of-window warnings keep schedules realistic.
**Work Packages** Bundle PMs and modernizations into named work packages for external quoting. Auto-generates RFQ numbers. One-click professional RFQ export (PDF-ready) with line items, cost estimates, terms and conditions, and signature blocks. Enforces one-to-one item assignment to prevent double-booking.
**Supply & Warehouse** Full supply requisition workflow from request through receipt. Supports NSN, CAGE code, manufacturer, and unit of measure fields. Auto-generates SRFQ numbers. Professional Supply RFQ export for vendor quoting. Inventory management with cycle counting (A/B/C classification), stock transactions (receive, issue, return, adjust), and full transaction history. Quarterly revalidation of open requisitions prevents stale orders.
**Platform Management** Multi-site support with Nextcloud group-based access control. Each platform (site, location, or organizational unit) is linked to a Nextcloud group. Users only see data for their assigned platforms.
**Mobile App** *(Pending Release on Google Play)* Pairs with the Maintain Ops Suite Android app for field technician access to PM completion, deficiency logging, deficiency closeout, and supply request status tracking — all from the field without needing a desktop.
The mobile app includes a 7-day free trial. After the trial period, a subscription is required for write access (logging deficiencies, completing PMs, closing deficiencies, requesting parts). Read-only access remains free.
- Monthly plan: $9.99/month - Annual plan: $79.99/year (save 33%)
Subscription revenue directly supports the continued development of Maintain Ops Suite. As an independent platform built to serve field operations teams of all sizes — from school districts to defense contractors — your subscription helps us keep building the tools you need.
